subject: Skyline renewal playforward + QBR scheduling
messages:
From: Sophie Reynolds <sophie.reynolds@skyline.ai>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 01 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal window — want to align on timeline + QBR options

Hi David / Ben,

Thanks again for the great partnership this year — we hit the ingestion targets and the latency improvements have been noticeable for our realtime pipelines. We're starting internal planning for our contract renewal and thinking about a modest capacity uplift + an additional embeddings seat bundle for a new search pilot.

High-level asks: 
- Updated pricing for a 12→24 month renewal (committed tokens + embeddings bundle)
- Options for a phased capacity uplift (50% baseline + burst windows)
- QBR to review usage, SLOs, and the pilot scope (would prefer late Aug / early Sep)

I've attached a short summary of our current consumption and proposed uplift. Can you confirm the earliest time your team can run a renewal kickoff and a 60–90 minute QBR? Also looping in procurement once we have basic commercial terms.

Attachments: Skyline_Renewal_Summary.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Sophie Reynolds
VP Partnerships, Skyline Health
Sophie.Reynolds@skyline.ai
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Reynolds <sophie.reynolds@skyline.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Aug 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window — want to align on timeline + QBR options

Thanks Sophie — really appreciate the summary. Congrats on the pilot progress.

We can absolutely run a kickoff and the QBR. Proposed plan (high level):
1) Renewal kickoff (30–45m) — this week: confirm scope (term length, committed tokens, embeddings bundle), identify procurement lead, and lock the MAP owner.
2) Internal sizing runbook — Ben will produce a capacity uplift plan (50% baseline + burst behavior) and quick cost delta by EOD Thu.
3) QBR (60–90m) — present usage trends, performance readouts, and a recommended commercial path (upgrade vs. staircase) — suggest Aug 29 or Sep 1 as options.

Kimberly, can you own legal/commercial checklist and prep the standard 12→24 term options + sample MSA amendments?
Ben — can you confirm capacity deltas and a rough $ impact?
Sophie — can you share the procurement contact (if different from this thread) and any internal approval windows we should know about?

I'll send a calendar hold for the kickoff and include a Doodle poll for the QBR times.

Thanks,
David Kim
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Reynolds <sophie.reynolds@skyline.ai>
Date: Wed, 02 Aug 2028 08:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window — want to align on timeline + QBR options

Adding the capacity lens — quick notes: 
- Current baseline: 1.2M tokens/day average, spikes to 3.4M on weekdays (search + chat flows).
- Proposed committed uplift: 50% baseline (so plan for ~1.8M/day committed), with two burst windows per month (up to 4M/day).
- Embeddings: add 5k monthly embedding units for the pilot; recommend discounted block pricing vs pay-as-you-go.

I attached a short MAP draft that lists milestones (kickoff, commercial draft, procurement PO, QBR). I'll have a simple cost delta table by Thu COB.

Attachments: MAP-draft.xlsx (xlsx)

Notes / asks:
- If we go 24 months, we can improve the committed discount by ~12–15% depending on burst tolerance.
- Need procurement lead and PO cadence from Skyline to model payment terms.

Ben
Sr. Account Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Sophie Reynolds <sophie.reynolds@skyline.ai>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 03 Aug 2028 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window — want to align on timeline + QBR options

Thanks, David and Ben — this is perfect. Procurement lead is Ethan Morris (ethan.morris@skyline.ai) and procurement inbox is procurement@skyline.ai. Our preferred approval window for commercial changes is Sept 10–20 to coincide with finance planning.

QBR availability: Aug 29 (10:00–11:30 PT) or Sep 1 (09:00–10:30 PT) both work for our team. We also prefer a short pre-read (1–2 pages) and a separate technical deep-dive for ops if needed.

I attached our PO guidance doc — it lists standard fields they'll expect on a PO and a sample timeline for 2–3 week internal procurement turnaround once terms are agreed.

Attachments: PO-guidance.docx (docx)

Looking forward to the kickoff.
Sophie
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Reynolds <sophie.reynolds@skyline.ai>, Ethan Morris <ethan.morris@skyline.ai>, Skyline Procurement <procurement@skyline.ai>
Date: Fri, 04 Aug 2028 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal window — want to align on timeline + QBR options

Team — quick coordination note and next steps (action owner in parentheses):
- Kickoff call: I'm sending a 30m hold for Mon Aug 6 at 10:00 PT to run scope and owners (David).
- MAP: Ben to circulate updated MAP with milestones + dates by Thu Aug 9 (Ben).
- Commercial options: Kimberly to draft and share 12→24 month term sheet + sample amendment by Wed Aug 8 (Kimberly).
- QBR: I'll create the Doodle poll and lock Aug 29 (10:00–11:30 PT) as primary, Sep 1 as fallback (David). Link included in shared Drive.
- Procurement: Sophie / Ethan to confirm PO cadence; we'll send a clean SOW + invoice template after terms are agreed (Sophie/Ethan).

Related links: https://doodle.com/poll/abc123-qbr-slots, https://redwood.app/drive/Shared/Skyline/SKY-2028-0931/MAP-draft.xlsx

I'll follow up with the kickoff agenda and a 1-page pre-read for the QBR.

Thanks all — small, focused steps and we should have a draft commercial by next week.

David Kim
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
